tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find free and free-to-start financial data sources, tools and models in the Signal Lab catalog by text and by filters (category, type, access badge, sign-up needed, license, task, verified, verified_since; see list_filters for the values). Returns up to 25 summary rows in name order, each with lastV

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Return one catalog entry by slug, with every field the catalog has for it (limits, coverage, auth, license, licenseNote, source URLs, lastVerified). Get slugs from search_catalog.

tools.name: compare_entries
tools.description: Place the catalog's fields for up to 5 entries side by side. Values are the catalog's own; a field the catalog does not have shows Not in catalog.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List the values the catalog uses for type, badge, auth, category, license, task, verified and lastVerified, with how many entries have each. Call this first to pick exact filter values.

tools.name: catalog_info
tools.description: Return the catalog's notice, schemaVersion, generated time, entry count and the download URLs of the full catalog as JSON and CSV.

tools.name: export_catalog
tools.description: Export the Signal Lab catalog as JSON or CSV: every entry, or only those matching the same filters as search_catalog (no result cap).
